# Building Participatory Smart Cities Through Aware Citizens: Evidence from Argentina

[Paper](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/15701255261459765) by María Verónica Alderete: “A smart city approach places citizens at the center of decision-making. However, only a small proportion of citizens actually engage in participatory initiatives. Although citizen participation has been extensively studied, limited empirical evidence exists on how citizens’ awareness of participatory initiatives relates to both their participation and their perception of municipal efforts to promote participation. This paper analyses these relationships using a Propensity Score Matching (PSM) approach based on survey data from a medium-sized city in Argentina. Since the factors associated with participation and perceptions of municipal promotion may also shape citizens’ awareness of government programs, PSM is used to improve comparability between aware and non-aware citizens and to examine the association between awareness of participatory initiatives and participation outcomes. The results show statistically significant differences in both participation propensity and perceptions of municipal promotion between citizens who are aware of these initiatives and those who are not. Awareness is positively associated with prior civic engagement, visiting the municipal website and age, and negatively associated with being a woman. Policy implications highlight the importance of disseminating successful participatory experiences and strengthening communication strategies to encourage broader citizen engagement…([More](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/15701255261459765))”.

# 從阿根廷證據看知情公民如何推動參與式智慧城市
María Verónica Alderete 的[論文](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/15701255261459765)：「智慧城市的做法把公民放在決策核心。然而，實際參與相關倡議的公民只占少數。雖然公民參與已受到廣泛研究，但關於公民對參與式倡議的認知，如何與他們的實際參與，以及他們對市政當局推動參與之努力的看法相關，目前仍缺乏實證證據。本文使用來自阿根廷一座中型城市的調查資料，透過傾向分數配對（Propensity Score Matching, PSM）方法分析這些關係。由於與參與及市府推廣觀感相關的因素，也可能影響公民是否知道政府方案，因此本文使用 PSM 來提升知情與不知情公民之間的可比較性，並檢視公民對參與式倡議的認知，與參與結果之間的關聯。結果顯示，知道這些倡議的公民與不知道的公民相比，在參與傾向與對市府推廣的觀感上，都有統計上顯著的差異。認知程度與過去的公民參與、造訪市政府網站及年齡呈正相關，與女性身分呈負相關。政策意涵則凸顯了傳播成功參與經驗、強化溝通策略的重要性，以鼓勵更廣泛的公民參與……（[更多](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/15701255261459765)）」
